approval_end_consistent.name: approval_end_consistent
approval_end_consistent.value: ("approval"."status" = 'granted' AND "approval"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "approval"."ended_by_id" IS NULL AND "approval"."end_reason" IS NULL) OR ("approval"."status" <> 'granted' AND "approval"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "approval"."end_reason" IS NOT NULL)

decision_source_context.name: decision_source_context
decision_source_context.value: ("decision"."revision_id" IS NULL OR "decision"."work_item_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("decision"."source_thread_id" IS NULL OR "decision"."revision_id" IS NOT NULL)

file_object_one_owner.name: file_object_one_owner
file_object_one_owner.value:
("file_object"."work_item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "file_object"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "file_object"."page_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("file_object"."work_item_id" IS NULL AND "file_object"."project_id" IS NULL AND "file_object"."page_id" IS NOT NULL)

intelligence_context_entry_scope_target.name: intelligence_context_entry_scope_target
intelligence_context_entry_scope_target.value:
("intelligence_context_entry"."scope" = 'organization' AND "intelligence_context_entry"."project_id" IS NULL AND "intelligence_context_entry"."team_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("intelligence_context_entry"."scope" = 'project' AND "intelligence_context_entry"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "intelligence_context_entry"."team_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("intelligence_context_entry"."scope" = 'team' AND "intelligence_context_entry"."team_id" IS NOT NULL AND "intelligence_context_entry"."project_id" IS NULL)

iteration_state_consistent.name: iteration_state_consistent
iteration_state_consistent.value: ("iteration"."state" = 'planned' AND "iteration"."started_at" IS NULL AND "iteration"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("iteration"."state" = 'active' AND "iteration"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "iteration"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("iteration"."state" = 'completed' AND "iteration"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "iteration"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

readiness_completion_consistent.name: readiness_completion_consistent
readiness_completion_consistent.value: ("readiness_check"."status" IN ('pending', 'running') AND "readiness_check"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("readiness_check"."status" IN ('passed', 'failed', 'error', 'skipped') AND "readiness_check"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL)

review_assignment_one_target.name: review_assignment_one_target
review_assignment_one_target.value: ("review_assignment"."user_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("review_assignment"."discipline_id" IS NOT NULL)

suggestion_resolution_consistent.name: suggestion_resolution_consistent
suggestion_resolution_consistent.value: ("suggestion"."status" IN ('draft', 'open') AND "suggestion"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "suggestion"."resolved_by_id" IS NULL AND "suggestion"."accepted_revision_id" IS NULL) OR ("suggestion"."status" = 'closed' AND "suggestion"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "suggestion"."resolved_by_id" IS NOT NULL AND "suggestion"."accepted_revision_id" IS NULL) OR ("suggestion"."status" = 'merged' AND "suggestion"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "suggestion"."resolved_by_id" IS NOT NULL AND "suggestion"."accepted_revision_id" IS NOT NULL AND "suggestion"."accepted_revision_id" <> "suggestion"."revision_id")

suggestion_decision_supersede_consistent.name: suggestion_decision_supersede_consistent
suggestion_decision_supersede_consistent.value: ("suggestion_decision"."superseded_at" IS NULL AND "suggestion_decision"."superseded_reason" IS NULL) OR ("suggestion_decision"."superseded_at" IS NOT NULL AND "suggestion_decision"."superseded_reason" IS NOT NULL)

thread_resolution_consistent.name: thread_resolution_consistent
thread_resolution_consistent.value: ("thread"."status" = 'open' AND "thread"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "thread"."resolved_by_id" IS NULL) OR ("thread"."status" = 'resolved' AND "thread"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "thread"."resolved_by_id" IS NOT NULL)

external_link_synced_identity.name: external_link_synced_identity
external_link_synced_identity.value: "work_item_external_link"."status" <> 'synced' OR ("work_item_external_link"."external_id" IS NOT NULL AND "work_item_external_link"."synced_at" IS NOT NULL)

page_commit_draft_provenance.name: page_commit_draft_provenance
page_commit_draft_provenance.value:
("page_commit"."draft_id" IS NULL AND "page_commit"."draft_epoch" IS NULL AND "page_commit"."draft_sequence" IS NULL)
        OR ("page_commit"."draft_id" IS NOT NULL AND "page_commit"."draft_epoch" IS NOT NULL AND "page_commit"."draft_sequence" IS NOT NULL)

page_pull_request_merge_consistent.name: page_pull_request_merge_consistent
page_pull_request_merge_consistent.value:
("page_pull_request"."status" = 'merged') = ("page_pull_request"."merged_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("page_pull_request"."merged_at" IS NULL) = ("page_pull_request"."merged_by_id" IS NULL)
        AND ("page_pull_request"."merged_at" IS NULL) = ("page_pull_request"."merge_commit_id" IS NULL)

page_pull_request_delete_consistent.name: page_pull_request_delete_consistent
page_pull_request_delete_consistent.value:
("page_pull_request"."deleted_at" IS NULL) = ("page_pull_request"."deleted_by_id" IS NULL)
        AND ("page_pull_request"."deleted_at" IS NULL OR "page_pull_request"."status" <> 'merged')

page_thread_commit_anchor.name: page_thread_commit_anchor
page_thread_commit_anchor.value:
"page_thread"."anchor"->>'kind' NOT IN ('commit', 'detached')
        OR ("page_thread"."commit_id" IS NOT NULL AND "page_thread"."commit_id" = "page_thread"."anchor"->>'commitId')

page_thread_resolution.name: page_thread_resolution
page_thread_resolution.value:
("page_thread"."status" = 'resolved') = ("page_thread"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("page_thread"."resolved_at" IS NULL) = ("page_thread"."resolved_by_id" IS NULL)

space_team_needs_project.name: space_team_needs_project
space_team_needs_project.value: "space"."team_id" IS NULL OR "space"."project_id" IS NOT NULL

specification_draft_line_base.name: specification_draft_line_base
specification_draft_line_base.value:
("specification_draft"."branch_id" IS NULL AND "specification_draft"."base_revision_id" IS NOT NULL AND "specification_draft"."base_commit_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("specification_draft"."branch_id" IS NOT NULL AND "specification_draft"."base_commit_id" IS NOT NULL AND "specification_draft"."base_revision_id" IS NULL)
